about: Who can think for the tree — one source for veraldar.org's door (the brain step + the yggdrasil.env it writes; synced copy) and the app door (naming the provider from YGG_UPSTREAM_BASE_URL, app/api/onboard). yggdrasil takes ANY upstream that speaks one of two wire styles (YGG_UPSTREAM_STYLE: openai = {base}/chat/completions, anthropic = {base}/v1/messages); these are presets, not a whitelist — 'other' takes any address. Models are starting points, editable in the door; check them against the provider's own model list. Proven on this tree 10-22: zai (glm-5.3-flash, anthropic style). The key is never asked in a web page: `keys` links to where the user makes one, the env carries a placeholder.
